verse.verse_1: Has there come to you the narration of the overwhelming (i.e. the Day of Resurrection);
verse.verse_2: Some faces, that Day, will be humiliated (in the Hell-fire, i.e. the faces of all disbelievers, Jews and Christians, etc.).
verse.verse_3: Labouring (hard in the worldly life by worshipping others besides Allah), weary (in the Hereafter with humility and disgrace).
verse.verse_4: They will enter in the hot blazing Fire,
verse.verse_5: They will be given to drink from a boiling spring,
verse.verse_6: No food will there be for them but a poisonous thorny plant,
verse.verse_7: Which will neither nourish nor avail against hunger.
verse.verse_8: (Other) faces, that Day, will be joyful,
verse.verse_9: Glad with their endeavour (for their good deeds which they did in this world, along with the true Faith of Islamic Monotheism).
verse.verse_11: Where they shall neither hear harmful speech nor falsehood,
verse.verse_12: Therein will be a running spring,
verse.verse_13: Therein will be thrones raised high,
verse.verse_17: Do they not look at the camels, how they are created?
verse.verse_18: And at the heaven, how it is raised?
verse.verse_19: And at the mountains, how they are rooted and fixed firm?
verse.verse_20: And at the earth, how it is spread out?
verse.verse_21: So remind them (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)), you are only a one who reminds.
verse.verse_22: You are not a dictator over them.
verse.verse_23: Save the one who turns away and disbelieves
verse.verse_24: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
verse.verse_25: Verily, to Us will be their return;
verse.verse_26: Then verily, for Us will be their reckoning.
